title: 964. Unique Paths III

examples.explanation: Two walks start at 1, step on every open cell exactly once, and finish at 2.
Four covering walks exist on this obstacle-free board.
No walk can both cover every open cell and end at the target.

hints: Count how many non-obstacle cells must be visited; a valid walk visits exactly that many cells including start and end.
Depth-first search with backtracking from the start cell, marking cells visited and unmarking on return.
When the search reaches the end cell, count it only if every open cell has been stepped on.
